aesthetic: Journal Restraint — academic editorial with dark navy section dividers, warm cream body slides, and red accent bars that shift column position across the deck like marginalia in a scholarly journal.
chromaticArc: Opens on midnight navy title, crosses to parchment cream for body runs, dips to navy on three section dividers at slides 1, 17, and 33, with red accent bars intensifying through the middle third then receding to sparse punctuation in the final act.
gridStrategy: Title zones alternate between left-anchored (col 0–2), centred (col 12–16), and right-offset (col 30–35) placements across consecutive slides; body zones vary from narrow 20-col emphasis columns to wide 40-col detail fields, with accent bars placed at shifting columns (col 0, col 57, col 28) to create a lateral rhythm across the deck.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Palatino used for all body text and labels; Futura reserved for headings, titles, and slide numbers

accentStrategy: Thin red (#B7311A) bars (span 1–2 cols, rowSpan 6–20) appear on ~65% of slides, each at a different column position — creating a staggered vertical rhythm across the deck like red thread stitching through a bound journal.
